As an Acquisition Data Scientist at Superhuman, you’ll shape how we acquire, activate, and expand our user base across a diverse portfolio of consumer and enterprise products. You’ll partner directly with Acquisition Marketing to improve the effectiveness of paid and organic channels, optimize the web funnel, and ensure every marketing dollar drives measurable growth.
Your work will span the Superhuman product suite, including Grammarly, Mail, Docs, Databases, GPTZero, Fathom, and Go. Because we’re building an integrated platform rather than a collection of standalone tools, insights from one product can unlock growth across the portfolio. You’ll tackle questions spanning budget allocation, channel attribution, SEO, AEO, cross-product activation, bundled offerings, and the full self-serve journey from first touch through activation and viral expansion.
You’ll be embedded in a cross-functional pod aligned to a Route to Market, working closely with Engineering, Finance, Marketing, Design, and User Research. With direct access to the leaders setting strategy, you’ll serve as the go-to data partner for acquisition: getting into the technical details, translating complex findings into clear recommendations on channel optimization, budget decisions, and new growth areas.
This role is for a hands-on data scientist who thrives in a fast-moving environment, enjoys solving complex growth problems, and wants their work to measurably influence outcomes across products, audiences, and go-to-market motions.
What you’ll do
* Be the go-to data person working directly with our Acquisition Marketing team, helping drive the efficacy of their marketing spend across our core paid and organic channels. This role is for someone who wants to be extremely hands-on, enjoys partnering cross-functionally with marketing peers, and wants to get deep into the technical weeds to find the best recommendations to ensure we optimize every marketing dollar we spend. * Be the embedded data science partner for the Superhuman Acquisition Marketing team — shaping channel strategy, budget allocation, prioritization, and roadmap decisions with evidence, not just fielding ad hoc requests. * Define and own the metrics that matter for Acquisition: LTV/CAC, new user growth, lifetime value, and web conversion rates to ensure we are responsible with our ad spend and driving continued conversion optimization. * Design and run incrementality tests across our most critical acquisition channels like Google, Meta, and YouTube. * Find opportunities for new user growth through budget reinvestment, new acquisition sources, international expansion, and website optimization. * Partner with our Acquisition, Engineering, Design, User Research, and Finance teams to build functional roadmaps for optimization of our acquisition channels across paid and organic sources. * Use data to craft a narrative, tell a story, and influence decisions to improve the efficiency of our ad channels and drive meaningful new user growth.
**Qualifications**
* You have 7+ years of data science experience and a track record of driving measurable impact for business and customers. * Advanced expertise in experimentation and causal inference, including designing incrementality tests and translating results into acquisition investment decisions. * Demonstrated ability to develop marketing mix and budget allocation models that measure channel effectiveness, identify diminishing returns, and optimize acquisition spend across channels. * You have strong applied statistics skills and machine learning skills, and you use them to drive product and growth decisions. * You influence cross-functional partners and turn technical insight into action through clear communication, empathetic building, and openness to ideas from anywhere. * You’re a self-starting, creative problem-solver who distills problems to their core and thrives with ambiguity. * You’re comfortable using AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code or Codex to move faster, and you have the judgment to validate and supervise their output. * You have a bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, data science, or a similar field); an advanced degree or equivalent practical experience is preferred.
**Nice To Haves**
* Familiarity working with ad platforms across Google, Meta, and YouTube. * Experience with SEO and AEO optimization and organic acquisition channels. * You’re familiar with experimentation platforms such as Statsig and modern data stacks such as Databricks. * You have experience working at a fast-growing startup, on AI-native consumer products, and/or in B2B/SaaS.
**Compensation And Benefits** Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing the following and more:
* Excellent health care (including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and fertility benefits) * Disability and life insurance options * 401(k) matching * Paid parental leave * 20 days of paid time off per year, 12 days of paid holidays per year, two floating holidays per year, and flexible sick time * Generous stipends (including those for caregiving, pet care, wellness, your home office, and more) * Annual professional development budget and opportunities
Superhuman takes a market-based approach to compensation, which means base pay may vary depending on your location. Our US locations are categorized into two compensation zones based on proximity to our hub locations.
Base pay may vary considerably depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The expected salary ranges for this position are outlined below by compensation zone and may be modified in the future.
We encourage you to apply
At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, political belief, or any other characteristic protected by law. Superhuman is an equal opportunity employer and a participant in the US federal E-Verify program (US). We also abide by the Employment Equity Act (Canada).

item.description:

The AWS Neuron Science Core Algorithm team is looking for talented Applied Scientists to push the frontier of hardware-aware machine learning for Trainium and Inferentia, the AWS Machine Learning accelerators. In this rare role at the intersection of LLM modeling, large-scale training systems, and hardware/datatype co-design, you own model and algorithm decisions jointly with AWS custom silicon. You will own solutions end-to-end from research through production, publish at top venues, and work alongside distinguished engineers and scientists in a strategic growth area for AWS.
**We Actively Work On These Areas**
* Low-precision training and inference: MXFP8, MXFP4, and sub-4-bit training and inference recipes, stochastic rounding, and Trn4 datatype exploration. * Trn-friendly architectures: model architectures that exploit hardware strengths without sacrificing quality. * System-aware optimizers & efficient distributed systems: efficient optimizers and distributed systems that give the best accuracy, co-designed with the hardware. * Foundation-model pre-training accuracy: end-to-end validation across model scales, catching training divergence early, and equivalence-checking tooling. * GenAI for systems: RL post-training for NKI kernel generation, mitigating reward-hacking and accelerating under low precision on Trn.

item.description:
**Description** Amazon Ads helps advertisers reach customers across Amazon's stores, Prime Video, Fire TV, Alexa, Twitch, and the open internet. Every ad we serve has to be safe, compliant, and trustworthy. The Ads Trust science team builds the AI systems that does this by reviewing billions of ads across text, image, video, audio, and product listings. We are looking for a Principal Applied Scientist to set the science direction for this work. This is an opportunity to apply as well as build state-of-the-art AI to problems where accuracy, scale, and customer trust all matter at once. This role suits a scientist who wants to own a hard problem end to end: inventing methods, proving them with strong evaluation, and putting them in front of customers.
You will design the core modeling approach behind moderation at Amazon scale. That includes multimodal large language and vision-language models, retrieval-based labeling, model distillation for production, and customer facing agentic systems. You will take ambiguous, high-stakes problems, turn them into scientific roadmaps, and stay hands-on in the technical decisions that matter most. item.description:
**Description** Join the next science and engineering revolution at Amazon's Delivery Foundation Model team, where you'll work alongside world-class scientists and engineers to pioneer the next frontier of logistics through advanced AI and foundation models.
We are seeking an exceptional Senior Applied Scientist to help develop innovative foundation models that enable delivery of billions of packages worldwide. In this role, you'll combine highly technical work with scientific leadership, ensuring the team delivers robust solutions for dynamic real-world environments. Your team will leverage Amazon's vast data and computational resources to tackle ambitious problems across a diverse set of Amazon delivery use cases.
Key job responsibilities
* Design and implement novel deep learning architectures combining a multitude of modalities, including image, video, and geospatial data. * Solve computational problems to train foundation models on vast amounts of Amazon data and infer at Amazon scale, taking advantage of latest developments in hardware and deep learning libraries. * As a foundation model developer, collaborate with multiple science and engineering teams to help build adaptations that power use cases across Amazon Last Mile deliveries, improving experience and safety of a delivery driver, an Amazon customer, and improving efficiency of Amazon delivery network. * Guide technical direction for specific research initiatives, ensuring robust performance in production environments. * Mentor fellow scientists while maintaining strong individual technical contributions.
A day in the life
As a member of the Delivery Foundation Model team, you’ll spend your day on the following:

**About The Team** The Delivery Foundation Model team combines ambitious research vision with real-world impact. We leverage Amazon's unparalleled computational infrastructure and extensive datasets to deploy state-of-the-art foundation models to improve the safety, quality, and efficiency of Amazon deliveries. item.title: Sr. Applied Scientist, AWS Specialists and Partner Prototyping - Amazon Web Services (AWS)
item.description:
**Description** Core to Amazon's DNA is its methodology around executing experiments and prototypes to find the quickest way to prove new ideas, technologies, and business models in a real-world environment. Experimentation fuels Amazon's innovation.
Our team does horizon exploration. We take emerging technology, including our own inventions, build working prototypes with customers and partners, and demonstrate what becomes possible before the rest of the market gets there. Prototyping is how we do the work. Pushing the technology horizon is why we do it.
If you are a highly creative problem solver who works to inspire, motivate, and define innovative solutions; are passionate about technology, understand cloud architectures and platforms, and are quick to pick up emerging technologies; are adept at working with customers to experiment with innovative approaches and validate the technical feasibility of solutions, this could be the role for you.
As a Senior Applied Scientist you sit directly with customers and partners. You help them envision complex uses of AWS by building working prototypes of specific use cases, tailored to their data, devices, and systems. Engagements run in short build cycles, typically four to six weeks, and are designed to be innovative and evaluative, demonstrating the art of the possible on AWS while proving a credible path to production.
You Will Work Across The Areas Where We Are Placing Our Biggest Bets. These Shift As The Technology Does, But Today They Include
* Physical AI and autonomous robotics. World models, vision-language-action (VLA) models, cloud-based and agentic VLA, real-to-sim and sim-to-real pipelines, and agentic control of physical systems. We challenge the assumption that these models have to live only at the edge. * Autonomous scientific discovery. Self-driving labs and instrument intelligence, where agents plan, run, and interpret experiments across fleets of scientific instruments. * Agentic developer intelligence. Multi-agent systems, code agents, and automated research workflows that change how software gets built. * Scaling what we learn. Turning one-off prototypes into reusable patterns and assets the broader field can pick up and run with.
You will not just apply these techniques. You will help decide which bets are worth making and prove or disprove them in the open with real customer problems.
Key job responsibilities
* As a key member of the AWS Specialists and Partner Prototyping team, ensure customer success through hands-on participation producing and demonstrating prototypes on the AWS platform. * Participate in deep architectural and scientific design discussions to ensure prototypes are crafted for successful deployment in the cloud and a credible path to production. * Bring applied science depth to engagements: frame the problem, select and adapt models, design experiments, and judge technical feasibility honestly, including when the answer is that an approach will not work. * Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to prototyping customers, partners, and internal business partners. * Act as a thought leader for your area of domain expertise across AWS, and share best-practice knowledge among the community. * Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as peer reviewed position papers, blogs, and reference patterns. * Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams, and sales, carrying real-world signal back to the teams building the services.
A day in the life
No two engagements look the same, which is the point. A typical week might include:
* Running a working session with a customer's scientists and engineers to pressure-test an idea and agree on what a prototype needs to prove. * Writing code and training or fine-tuning models in the lab, often against the customer's own data, devices, or robots. * Pairing with a prototyping SA and engagement manager, the standard pod you deliver alongside, to keep the build moving and the scope honest. * Demonstrating a working prototype live and walking stakeholders through what it does, what it does not yet do, and what production would take. * Capturing what you learned as a reusable pattern or publication so the next team does not start from zero. * Spending time on the horizon itself: reading, experimenting with a new model or technique, and forming a point of view on where a bet is heading.
You will move between hands-on building and customer-facing explanation constantly. The best people in this role are equally comfortable in a research paper, a code editor, and a room full of executives.
**About The Team** Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Utility Computing (UC)
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (IoT), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
**Basic Qualifications**
* PhD, or Master's degree and 5+ years of applied research experience * Experience in building machine learning models for business application * Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language * Experience using managed ML/AI solutions
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience conveying complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences * Experience working with Advanced Compute technologies including, but not limited to: Accelerated Compute, High Performance Compute, Visual/Spatial Compute, and/or IoT. * Experience with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT or similar platforms in production environments, or experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution * Experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware, or experience in machine learning, data

item.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - 3D Reconstruction - Applied Intuition
item.description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.
*We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions* **About The Role And Team** We are looking for senior machine learning engineers to advance the core reconstruction technology behind Neural Simulation, our state-of-the-art product for turning real-world driving data into high-fidelity, photorealistic simulation environments. As part of this team, you will push the boundaries of what the product can do, raising reconstruction quality, scaling to ever-larger volumes of data, and making it more useful for customers who rely on it to train and validate their autonomy systems. Your work will directly shape how the largest OEMs in the world develop the next generation of data-driven autonomous vehicles.
This role is ideal for engineers who thrive at the intersection of 3D computer vision, graphics, and machine learning, and who are excited to take a state-of-the-art product further by bringing the latest research into production and solving the hardest simulation gaps in Physical AI.
**At Applied Intuition, You Will**
* Advance the learning-based reconstruction methods at the core of our product, such as 3D Gaussian Splatting and NeRFs, bringing the latest research into production to improve fidelity, robustness, and scalability * Push the limits of neural reconstruction for large-scale, dynamic driving scenes, including:
+ Dynamic actor reconstruction and scene editing + Novel view synthesis and multi-sensor rendering (camera, LiDAR) + Scaling reconstruction quality and throughput across large volumes of fleet data
* Explore and productionize feed-forward reconstruction approaches that reduce per-scene optimization cost and enable reconstruction at scale * Define and build evaluation metrics, benchmarks, and validation workflows that measure reconstruction fidelity and sim-to-real gap * Work closely with customers to understand their pain points and implement technical solutions in the Neural Simulation product * Collaborate closely with Infra, Autonomy, Research and other product teams to deliver end-to-end solutions * Take ownership of critical technical components and influence architecture and product decisions
**We're Looking For Someone Who Has**
* 5+ years of experience developing and shipping ML or computer vision systems * A minimum of a Bachelor's degree in computer science, physics, robotics, or equivalent * Strong hands-on experience with modern learning-based 3D reconstruction techniques, such as 3D Gaussian Splatting and NeRFs * A solid foundation in multi-view geometry, camera models, and differentiable rendering * Proficiency in Python and PyTorch, along with C++ and/or CUDA * A proven ability to turn research ideas into robust, production-quality software * Strong problem-solving skills and comfort with ambiguity
**Nice To Have**
* Experience with feed-forward or generalizable Gaussian Splatting and reconstruction models * A background in computer vision (e.g., SfM, SLAM, photogrammetry) and/or computer graphics (e.g., rendering, rasterization, ray tracing) * A track record of shipping ML products with clearly defined evaluation metrics and benchmarks * Experience in autonomous driving or robotics, including working with multi-sensor data (camera, LiDAR, radar) * Peer-reviewed research at conferences such as CVPR, ICCV/ECCV, NeurIPS, SIGGRAPH, ICRA, or IROS * A Master's degree or PhD in computer science, physics, robotics, or related fields
*Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.* *Applied Intuition is an equal opportunity employer and federal contractor or subcontractor. item.title: (USA) Staff, Data Scientist - Walmart
item.description:
Position Summary...Role summary:
Walmart is seeking a Staff Data Scientist to lead advanced measurement and analytics solutions that address complex marketing and business challenges at scale. This role will focus on Media Mix Modeling (MMM), experimentation, causal inference, and broader marketing analytics to measure marketing effectiveness and inform strategic investment decisions.
The ideal candidate combines deep statistical and technical expertise with strong business acumen—someone who can develop rigorous analytical solutions, translate complex findings into actionable recommendations, and influence decisions across Marketing and the broader organization.
About the team:
Our team sits within Marketing Analytics and develops rigorous, actionable measurement solutions to help Walmart understand and optimize the impact of marketing investments. Our work spans three core areas: Media Mix Modeling, including measurement of High Value Habits; experimentation and causal inference, including geo-, store-, and customer-level measurement; and broader marketing analytics connecting media activity, customer behavior, and business outcomes.
The team is the combination of advanced data science, experimentation, and real-world business impact at Walmart scale. We partner closely with Marketing, Finance and other analytics teams to turn complex measurement challenges into insights that shape marketing strategy and investment decisions.
What you'll do...
* Lead the development and advancement of MMM and marketing measurement methodologies, including model development, validation, automation, and interpretation. * Design and analyze experiments and causal inference studies, including geo-, store-, and customer-level tests, to quantify incremental marketing impact. * Build frameworks that connect experimental evidence with observational and MMM measurement, improving confidence in marketing effectiveness and investment decisions. * Apply advanced statistical and causal methods to complex business questions involving customer behavior, media performance, and marketing incrementality. * Translate technical findings into clear business insights and strategic recommendations for senior stakeholders. * Partner cross-functionally to identify high-impact measurement opportunities, define analytical roadmaps, and develop scalable solutions.
What you'll bring...
* Advanced degree in Statistics, Economics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent experience. * Deep expertise in statistical modeling and causal inference with hand-on experience in experiment design and measurement. * Hands-on experience developing Media Mix Models, with an understanding of model validation, response curves, incrementality, and attribution. * Strong programming skills in Python and SQL with vibe coding, with the ability to independently develop and evaluate analytical solutions. * Strong communication and storytelling skills, particularly the ability to explain sophisticated methodologies and findings to non-technical and senior audiences. * Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, collaborate across functions, and provide technical direction on complex analytical initiatives.
At Walmart, we offer competitive pay as well as performance-based bonus awards and other great benefits for a happier mind, body, and wallet. Health benefits include medical, vision and dental coverage. Financial benefits include 401(k), stock purchase and company-paid life insurance. Paid time off benefits include PTO (including sick leave), parental leave, family care leave, bereavement, jury duty, and voting. Other benefits include short-term and long-term disability, company discounts, Military Leave Pay, adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, and more. You will also receive PTO and/or PPTO that can be used for vacation, sick leave, holidays, or other purposes. The amount you receive depends on your job classification and length of employment. It will meet or exceed the requirements of paid sick leave laws, where applicable. For information about PTO, see https://one.walmart.com/notices. Live Better U is a Walmart-paid education benefit program for full-time and part-time associates in Walmart and Sam's Club facilities. Programs range from high school completion to bachelor's degrees, including English Language Learning and short-form certificates. Tuition, books, and fees are completely paid for by Walmart.
Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to a specific plan or program terms.

item.title: AI & Machine Learning Engineering Consultant - Databricks - Manager - Consulting- Location OPEN - EY
item.description:
Location: Anywhere in Country
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
**The opportunity** Our AI, Data & Engineering team helps apply cutting edge technology and techniques to bring solutions to our clients. As part of that, you'll sit side-by-side with clients and diverse teams from EY to create a well-rounded approach to advising and solving challenging problems, some of which have not been solved before. No two days will be the same, and with constant research and development, you'll find yourself building knowledge that can be applied across a wide range of projects now, and in the future. You'll need to have a passion for continuous learning, stay ahead of the trends, and influence new ways of working so you can position solutions in the most relevant and innovative way for our clients. You can expect heavy client interaction in a fast-paced environment and the opportunity to develop your own career path for your unique skills and ambitions.
EY is experiencing significant growth in consulting services centered on Databricks, a market-leading data and AI platform. We are seeking an accomplished leader who combines strong business acumen, consulting experience, and technical credibility to help clients realize value from this strategic platform. In this role, you will collaborate with clients and Databricks account, sector, and leadership teams to shape and deliver generative AI use cases, advanced data and AI solutions, and scalable platforms.
In this role, you will research, build, and implement scalable AI, machine learning, generative AI, and agentic systems that learn, reason, and generate outputs tailored to business requirements on Databricks. You will enhance data pipelines and storage on Databricks, ensuring data is clean, accurate, and optimized for XOps processes. Additionally, you will monitor and evaluate learning processes to continuously improve high-performance models, collaborating with other data and analytics professionals to industrialize analysis into effective analytics solutions. You will deliver solutions on Databricks, from data pipelines to agents in production.
**Your Key Responsibilities** As a Manager in Model Engineering, you will play a pivotal role in delivering innovative solutions that drive business success. You will work with a wide variety of clients to deliver modern AI engineering, machine learning, and generative AI technologies. Your teams will design and build scalable solutions that unify, enrich, and derive insights from varied data sources across a broad technology landscape. You will help our clients navigate the complex world of modern data science, analytics, and software engineering. We'll look to you to provide guidance and perform technical development tasks to ensure AI solutions are responsibly engineered, evaluated, deployed, and maintained to support the ongoing business needs of our clients.
You will be joining a dynamic and interdisciplinary team of scientists and engineers who love to tackle the most challenging computational problems for our clients. We love to think creatively, build applications efficiently, and collaborate in both the ideation of solutions and the pursuit of new opportunities. Many on our team have advanced academic degrees or equivalent experience in industry.
**Your responsibilities will include:**
* Leading AI workstreams from solution design through production deployment and ongoing optimization, focusing on the Databricks platform * Leading teams building data engineering pipelines, AI solutions (machine learning, generative AI, and agentic AI), and the pipelines that support AI solutions on Databricks * Continuously improving processes by identifying innovative solutions through research and analysis * Managing multidisciplinary teams to deliver complex AI engineering initiatives, with accountability for quality, responsible deployment, and results * Engaging actively with clients, participating in daily working sessions, and leading workstreams from planning through execution to closure * Designing, building, and governing domain ontologies and semantic models that define business concepts, relationships, and rules for AI solutions, knowledge graphs, and enterprise data products * Applying a product-centric development approach by partnering with product, business, data science, and engineering stakeholders to define user needs, prioritize reusable capabilities, and iteratively deliver measurable outcomes across the product lifecycle * Identifying opportunities for additional services and managing engagement economics
**Skills And Attributes For Success** To excel in this role, you will need a blend of technical expertise and strong interpersonal skills. This role will work to deliver tech at speed, innovate at scale and put humans at the center. Provide technical guidance and share knowledge with team members with diverse skills and backgrounds. Consistently deliver quality client services focusing on more complex, judgmental and/or specialized issues surrounding emerging technology. Demonstrate technical capabilities and professional knowledge. Learn about EY and its service lines and actively assess and present ways to apply knowledge and services
The following attributes will make a significant impact:
* Translating AI strategy into a implementable Model Engineering activities that aligns with the client’s goals, mission and vision * Leading teams of AI engineers, data engineers, and data scientists in the delivery of production-grade solutions for clients on Databricks; These include data engineering pipelines, AI solutions (machine learning, generative AI, and agentic AI), and the pipelines that support AI solutions * Implementing product-centric AI solutions on Databricks, from discovery and roadmap definition through iterative delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement, with measurable business and user outcomes. * Working across design, build, deploy, and operate phases to deliver production-grade data and AI pipelines, governed business ontologies, and semantic models on Databricks, ensuring solutions are reliable, reusable, and aligned with client business processes * Experience applying a product-centric development approach to data and AI solutions by defining user outcomes, prioritizing reusable capabilities, managing roadmaps and backlogs, incorporating user feedback, measuring adoption and business value, and continuously improving products after launch * Staying abreast of AI technology trends and provide directional guidance and recommendations around AIOps, MLOps, and AgentOps tools and solutions on Databricks that fit their needs and integrate with their existing ecosystem * Applying combined business and technical knowledge to develop and execute ModelOps target architecture on Databricks that enables implementation and monitoring of AI at scale, with tools like Unity Catalog and Model Serving * Collaborating with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Cloud Engineers, and Platform Engineers, DevOps to implement and sustain solutions in the Databricks platform * Staying abreast of industry trends, technology innovations and AI regulatory requirements across the globe * Understanding clients’ overall data, AI and technology landscape and business priorities and success measures * Strong team collaboration and experience working with a diverse team in a hybrid model (on site and remote) * Fostering relationships with client personnel at appropriate levels * Consistently delivering quality client services * Driving high-quality work products within expected timeframes and on budget * Collaborating, influencing and building consensus through constructive relationships and effective listening * So

item.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Perception - Autonomous Driving - NVIDIA
item.description:
Intelligent machines powered by Artificial Intelligence computers that can learn, reason, and interact with people are no longer science fiction. Today, a self-driving vehicle powered by AI can meander through a country road at night and find its way. NVIDIA's GPU runs Deep Learning algorithms, simulating human intelligence, and acts as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving vehicles that can perceive and understand the world.
Our team is building the machine learning backbone of the Perception component for NVIDIA DRIVE AV. We are seeking the best Machine Learning Engineers with a background in computer vision, LiDAR & camera perception, multi-sensor fusion and AI infrastructure who are passionate about solving the hardest problems for self-driving cars. Are you interested in inventing human-level AI for perception under real world conditions? If so, join us!
**What You'll Be Doing**
* Model Development: Design, train, and optimize innovative machine learning models for LiDAR/camera perception and multi-sensor fusion (e.g., object detection/classification, image classification, semantic segmentation, tracking). * Develop and coordinate entire ML workflows, covering data pipelines, model training, model metrics, continuous performance instrumentation, and reporting. * Productization: Take ML models and algorithms from initial evaluation and experimentation all the way to product level on the NVIDIA DRIVE AV platform, developing highly efficient product code in C++. * Innovation: Keep track of the latest developments in machine learning, and incorporate techniques that improve platform performance. * Collaborate with LiDAR/camera teams, developers, engineers, and managers to turn complex ideas into reliable solutions for autonomous driving.
**What We Need To See**
* MS or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 8+ years of relevant proven industry experience applying machine learning to address real-world problems. * Strong C++ and Python programming and debugging skills with experience in developing for large, complex systems. * Deep practical experience applying machine learning to lidar/camera perception and multi-sensor fusion in automotive or related fields. * Experience with deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and a strong understanding of the mathematical foundations of ML. * Building and sustaining training and essential metric workflows for large-scale datasets. * Excellent communication and analytical skills. Self-motivated drive to solve hard problems.
**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Multi-sensor fusion, LiDAR or Camera Perception Experience: Proven track record of developing and shipping deep learning models for LiDAR/Camera and Multi-Sensor Fusion in a production environment. * Advanced Model Knowledge: Familiarity with modern network architectures like Transformers and their application to visual recognition tasks. * AV Production Experience: A history of delivering ML features and models into a production autonomous vehicle stack or a related robotics product. * Performance Optimization: Experience with model optimization for real-time inference on embedded or automotive platforms (e.g., using TensorRT).
We believe that realizing self-driving vehicles will be a defining contribution of our generation (e.g., traffic accidents are responsible for ~1.25 million deaths per year worldwide). We have the funding and scale, but we need your help on our team. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers with some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working here. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!
#AutonomousVehicles
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:
184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4; and 224,000 USD – 356,500 USD for Level 5.
You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.
Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 3, 2026.
This posting is for an existing vacancy.
NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.
NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

item.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Driver Refinement & Validation - Waymo
item.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.
The Driver Refinement and Validation (DRV) organization’s goal is to improve the Waymo Driver performance by owning the end-to-end driving behavior for various onroad problems clusters. We work with upstream and the downstream teams on developing the ML models and integrating into the Waymo Driver. As part of the data flywheel team you will take advantage of millions of miles of driving data from a diverse set of sensors to (1) develop methods for efficiently and continuously learning from large scale real-world data, to (2) develop new post training methodologies (3) explore state of the art modeling techniques (4) build tooling and infra to democratize the use of these technologies.
**You Will**
* Design, develop, and implement ML solutions for autonomous vehicle planning including, but not limited to, modeling, reward/loss shaping, finetuning, reinforcement learning, data shaping, etc. * Develop model evaluation recipes and metrics for measuring and improving performance of pre-trained and fine-tuned models * Develop data mining techniques to curate dataset samples from large corpus of driving data * Develop novel ways to learn from unsupervised driving data. Be able to apply SOTA techniques within Waymo’s tooling/infrastructure. * Leverage large language models and world foundation models for reasoning, decision making and multi-modality generation. * Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in autonomous driving and machine learning, and be able quickly prototype, experiment and deploy novel SOTA solutions. * Build data tooling/infrastruction to unblock experimentation. * Collaborate closely with partner teams such as perception, research, simulation, labeling, and evaluation.
**You Have**
* Bachelors in Computer Science or a similar discipline, or an equivalent amount of deep learning experience * 5+ years experience in Machine Learning and/or Computer Vision * Proficiency in Python and at least one deep learning frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow) * Experience in applied machine learning including deep learning, feature engineering, loss/reward shaping, data shaping, fine tuning and model evaluation * Experience with post-training techniques including such as reinforcement learning, close loop training, RLHF, etc. * Experience in dealing with large scale models and datasets * Experience in integrating ML models into production systems.
**We Prefer**
* MS or PhD Degree in Machine Learning, Robotics, Computer Science or a similar discipline * Publications at top-tier conferences like CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, ICLR, ICML, ICRA, IROS, RSS, NeurIPS, AAAI, IJCV, PAMI * Experience in the autonomous driving domain, including areas like motion planning or perception * Experience with Large Language Models (LLM) or Vision Language Models (VLM), prompt engineering and chain of thought reasoning * Experience in applying ML to a robotics problem * Proficiency in C++
The expected base salary range for this full-time position across US locations is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the role location or, if the role can be performed remote, the specific salary range for your preferred location, during the hiring process.
Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.
Salary Range
$213,000—$263,000 USD

item.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer, Recommendation Algorithm - ByLabs
item.description:
**About the Role**
As a Principal Recommendation Algorithm Engineer, you will be responsible for personalized recommendations across the trading products, content, and community. You will understand how user behavior evolves across scenarios; model cross-scenario behavior sequences, short- and long-term interests, and changes in intent; and jointly optimize objectives such as clicks, conversions, and retention to improve recommendation performance and user experience.
You will work closely with recommendation engineering, growth product and operations, and data science teams to build a high-throughput, low-latency, highly available personalization system serving more than 80 million users globally. You will drive technical advances in personalized recommendations, distribution strategies, user understanding, and content understanding.
**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and improve recommendation models for the trading products, content, and community. Use large-scale user behavior data to model user interests accurately and improve recommendation performance and user experience. * Explore cross-domain transfer and cold-start optimization across business scenarios, taking each scenario's characteristics into account to improve cross-scenario recommendation results and cold-start coverage. * Optimize multi-objective ranking models for CTR, CVR, LTV, and other outcomes. Design mechanisms for combining ranking objectives and balance clicks, conversions, and long-term value under scenario-specific constraints. * Model cross-scenario user behavior sequences, short- and long-term interests, and changes in intent. Develop reusable user representations to address scenario transfer, sparse feedback, and cold-start challenges. * Explore generative recommendation approaches, including semantic IDs and generative candidate generation, and integrate generative methods with discriminative recommendation pipelines.
**Major Requirements**
* At least 4 years of experience developing search, advertising, or recommendation algorithms at a consumer-facing internet company, with a deep understanding of retrieval, ranking, and multi-objective modeling. * Strong computer science fundamentals and proficiency in at least one of Python, Java, or C++. You write well-structured code, apply sound design principles, and enjoy tackling challenging problems. * Strong analytical and logical thinking, with the ability to identify problems and opportunities in data. * An interest in emerging technologies and the ability to approach challenging problems with clarity and sound reasoning. * Good business judgment and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate on and solve business problems.
**Nice-to-have:**
* Search, advertising, or recommendation algorithm experience at major technology companies * Experience with multi-objective modeling, short- and long-term user sequence modeling, personalized uplift modeling, or generative modeling. * Publications at leading international conferences, including but not limited to KDD, SIGIR, RecSys, ACL, or NeurIPS. * An AI-driven approach and hands-on experience bringing LLM or agent applications into production for search, advertising, or recommendation use cases.
**Why Join Us**
* **A multi-domain recommendation challenge in fintech:** Go beyond a single domain such as video or e-commerce. You will build personalization capabilities across trading products, market intelligence, community content, campaigns, and AI-powered investment workflows. * **Proven business impact with substantial room for ML advancement:** Our current recommendation system has demonstrated a 71% increase in CTR and a 1,285% increase in conversion rate, with significant potential for an ML-native upgrade. * **Work at the intersection of AI and recommendations:** Build where traditional recommender systems, generative AI, and LLM agents meet—one of the most active frontiers in engineering. * **An opportunity to lead, not just follow:** Our combination of trading, content, community, AI, and campaigns creates distinctive technical challenges and enables rapid iteration. * **Global scale:** Serve more than 80 million users across over 200 countries, tackling the real-world complexity of large-scale, real-time systems.

item.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Retention - Taskrabbit
item.description:
**About Taskrabbit:**
Taskrabbit is a marketplace platform that conveniently connects people with Taskers to handle everyday home to-do’s, such as furniture assembly, handyman work, moving help, and much more.
At Taskrabbit, we want to transform lives one task at a time. As a company we celebrate innovation, inclusion and hard work. Our culture is collaborative, pragmatic, and fast-paced. We’re looking for talented, entrepreneurially minded and data-driven people who also have a passion for helping people do what they love. Together with IKEA, we’re creating more opportunities for people to earn a consistent, meaningful income on their own terms by building lasting relationships with clients in communities around the world.
Taskrabbit is a hybrid company with employees distributed across the US and EU and a Built In — Best Places to Work (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025) continually ranked across multiple national and regional categories. Join us at Taskrabbit, where your work will be meaningful, your ideas valued, and your potential unleashed!
**This role is hybrid requiring 2 days in office at our San Francisco or NYC hub every Tuesday & Wednesday.**
**About the Role**
Machine Learning is a cornerstone at Taskrabbit, and we're looking for a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to join our team and lead the next phase of our customer retention strategy. This is a critical, full-stack role for an individual who is passionate about the end-to-end lifecycle: from initial research and model development to building the robust systems that power **repeat customer engagement and lifetime value growth at scale.**
Taskrabbit's greatest growth opportunity lies in deepening customer relationships and accelerating repeat purchases. Our most valuable customers are those who return frequently, discover new service categories, and increase their spending over time. There's significant untapped potential in the marketplace: repeat customers spend 3-5x more than one-time users, and category expansion unlocks new revenue streams within our existing customer base.

**What You'll Work On:**

**Compensation & Benefits:**
At Taskrabbit, our approach to compensation is designed to be competitive, transparent, and equitable. Total compensation consists of base pay + bonus + benefits + perks. The base pay range for this position is $175,000 - $230,000. This range is representative of base pay only, and does not include any other total cash compensation amounts, such as company bonus or benefits. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed above and will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, qualifications, geography, and level.
**You’ll love working here because:**
* ****Taskrabbit is a Hybrid Company.**** We value flexibility and choice but also stay committed to regular in-person connection. * ****The People.**** You will be surrounded by some of the most talented, supportive, smart, and kind leaders and teams -- people you can be proud to work with! * ****The Diverse Culture.**** We believe that we make better decisions when our workforce reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate. Women make up half of our leadership team and our diversity representation is above that of the tech industry average. * ****The Perks.**** Taskrabbit offers our employees with employer-paid health insurance and a 401k match with immediate vesting for our US based employees. We offer all of our global employees generous and flexible time off with 2 company-wide closure weeks, Taskrabbit product stipends, wellness + productivity + education stipends, IKEA discounts, reproductive health support, and more. **Benefits vary by country of employment.**

item.title: Senior ML Applied Scientist , Frontier AI Startup Team - Amazon Web Services (AWS)
item.description:
**Description** AI-native startups now train their own models, post-train open-weight models for their products, and serve inference at volumes where cost per output decides their margins. The startup team of the AWS Frontier AI Services puts applied scientists to work directly with those founders and their engineers. We're hiring a Senior Applied Scientist in North America to own those engagements with our strategists end to end: scope the problem with the founding team, design and run the experiments, and ship working code into the startup's stack on AWS. The problems are open-ended and the timelines run in weeks, so your scientific judgment sets both the approach and the bar for done.
Key job responsibilities
* Work directly with founders, CTOs and ML leads at AI startups to define the problem and agree on a production target and an evaluation plan. Then deliver against them in six-to-twelve-week engagements, with the startup's own engineers working alongside you. * Improve model quality for the startup's use case by post-training open-weight models. That covers supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, reinforcement learning (for example GRPO), distillation, and the synthetic data and evaluation sets that show whether it worked. * Cut training and inference cost and latency on NVIDIA GPUs and AWS Trainium. Profile where the compute goes, apply quantization, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse, batching, parallelism and kernel-level tuning, and measure cost per output before and after. * Invent new methods when published ones fall short of the customer's target, and publish the results at peer-reviewed venues, on AWS blogs and as open-source code. * Turn each engagement into assets the next one can reuse: reference implementations, evaluation harnesses and playbooks. Take the gaps you find in Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker and AWS Trainium back to those service teams as specific requests. * Raise the science bar on the team. Review experiment designs and code, mentor scientists and engineers, and help account teams and strategists judge which startup requests need a scientist.
A day in the life
You start the day on a call with the CTO of a robotics startup whose vision-language model misses objects in low light. Before anyone changes the model, you agree on an evaluation set built from their own camera footage. Mid-morning you check an overnight reinforcement-learning run for another startup: reward is up but two task categories regressed, so you write up why and what to try next. After lunch you join an AWS account manager and a GenAI strategist to scope a request from a voice AI company that needs lower inference latency before it scales up. You leave with a two-week profiling plan and one go/no-go metric. You end the day reviewing a teammate's experiment design and editing a workshop paper drawn from last quarter's engagement.
**About The Team** We're applied scientists and GenAI strategists working as one team with venture-backed, AI-native startups, from the first discovery call to a model running in production. The work spans large language and vision-language models, agents, voice, multimodal retrieval and physical AI, including world and action models. We judge an engagement by what the startup ships. Startups make platform decisions in weeks, so we scope quickly, share results early, and say plainly when something isn't working. This role focuses on startups in North America. You'll work with AWS account teams, solutions architects and service teams, and with Amazon's wider science community.
**Basic Qualifications**
* PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience * Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc. * Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc. * 6+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. **Job Summary** **Your Career** As a Senior Principal Machine Learning Engineer, you will serve as the chief technical authority driving architectural strategy, design excellence, and AI innovation across cloud security systems. **Your Impact** Strategic Leadership & Team Direction

Evaluate frontline AI research, filter transient hype from production-viable technology, and steer engineering investments toward high-leverage architectural paths. * Cultivate Engineering Culture: Champion engineering rigor by instituting RFC standards, leading architectural review boards (ARBs), and mentoring Staff and Principal engineers to scale technical excellence across teams. * Cross-Functional Partnership: Bridge the gap between Product Management, Security Researchers, Data Science, and Infrastructure teams. Translate ambiguous business objectives and complex threat landscapes into concrete technical requirements, milestone architectures, and executable designs.
Large-Scale System Design & Architecture
* End-to-End System Design: Lead the macro- and micro-level architecture of highly distributed, fault-tolerant cloud systems that process real-time security data streams at petabyte scale. * Agentic Ecosystems: Architect robust, production-grade agentic frameworks featuring dynamic multi-step planning, stateful memory persistence, secure tool execution, and deterministic guardrails. * Data & Telemetry Backbone: Drive the architectural blueprint for ingestion, preprocessing, and feature engineering pipelines using Apache Spark, SQL, and BigQuery across Google Cloud platforms (Dataproc, GKE, and GCP SDKs).

Pinpoint failures across training data distribution, loss convergence, or prompt/context limits, and lead targeted remediation via fine-tuning (SFT, DPO, RL, LoRA/PEFT). * GPU & Accelerator Debugging: Troubleshoot low-level compute bottlenecks on distributed GPU clusters, resolving distributed training/inference issues, CUDA out-of-memory (OOM) states, NCCL communication overhead, and kernel performance stalls.
**Qualifications** **Your Experience**

**Preferred Qualifications (Strong Bonus)**
* Cybersecurity Domain Expertise: Deep background in threat modeling, endpoint detection and response (EDR), SIEM architectures, or cloud security posture management. * Network Topologies: Working knowledge of L3–L7 network protocols, packet telemetry, and deep packet inspection systems. * Industry Thought Leadership: Contributions to open-source foundation model tooling, published research, or active participation in the broader AI systems community.

item.title: Lead Data Scientist - Air
item.description:
**Company Description** Air is the leader in Enterprise Readiness. Our mission is to establish readiness as a real-time condition that is continuously achieved. Today, a dangerous Readiness Gap exists between what the front line needs and what is delivered. Our AI-native platform, Air Enterprise Readiness, aligns development, production, delivery, and sustainment into one coordinated execution system for government agencies and industrial suppliers. By revealing true capacity, exposing real constraints, coordinating resources, and executing at the speed of operational demands, the front line gets what it needs to succeed.
**Job Description** We are seeking an exceptional Data Science leader to technically lead and own major areas of Air’s core AI and Data Science, advancing the modeling, algorithms, and scientific foundations that power our products, including the data science behind Enterprise Readiness. This role will develop foundational AI capabilities that become core building blocks of Air’s products and can be leveraged by Forward Deployed Data Science teams across dozens of deployments and clients.
This leader will set the strategic direction for Core Data Science and Applied AI, identify and prioritize high-impact technical opportunities, and drive the development of reusable modeling capabilities. The role will own the end-to-end Data Science lifecycle, from problem formulation and model development and training through evaluation and validation in real-world, end-to-end use cases. We are seeking a leader who can combine deep technical expertise with strong organizational leadership to build a high-impact core science function and translate advanced Data Science into capabilities that scale across the company.
In order to do this job well, you should have a broad foundation across Data Science and deep expertise in one or more core areas such as optimization, simulation, forecasting, reinforcement learning, causal inference, or foundation modeling. You should be able to lead large-scale Data Science initiatives end to end, from identifying opportunities and working directly with clients, through partnering with Forward Deployed Data Science teams to understand their needs, to model development, evaluation, and deployment aligned with client outcomes. You should be comfortable leading cross-functional efforts spanning Data Science, platforms, Agentic AI, and data engineering, bringing together diverse technical disciplines to solve complex problems. You will also drive the scientific roadmap for the areas you own, establish technical direction and best practices, and mentor and develop other Data Scientists to build deep expertise and advance the organization’s scientific capabilities.
This role is a full-time position located out of our office in Arlington, VA / Pittsburgh, PA / San Francisco, CA.
This role may require up to 10% travel.
Scope of Responsibilities
* Lead Core Data Science Strategy: Define and drive the technical roadmap for core Data Science capabilities, translating complex client and business challenges into scalable data science and Applied AI across the Air Enterprise readiness. * Set Scientific Standards and Drive Innovation: Establish best practices for model architecture, experimentation, evaluation, and deployment; assess emerging research and technologies; and translate scientific advances into robust, cost-effective, production-ready capabilities. * Advance Core Modeling Capabilities: Drive the development of state-of-the-art methods across specialized areas such as simulation, optimization, forecasting, predictive modeling, reinforcement learning, and foundation models, applying deep expertise in one or more domains. * Own End-to-End Scientific Execution: Lead large-scale Data Science projects from problem formulation and ideation through model development, training, evaluation, and production deployment, ensuring solutions deliver measurable client impact. * Build Scalable Decision Intelligence Platforms: Working together with MLOps team, guide the development of reusable modeling capabilities that integrate with data platforms, Agentic AI systems, and client workflows to power complex decision intelligence solutions across diverse defense use cases. * Drive Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Align Data Science, Applied AI, Forward Deployed Data Science, Product, Platform, and Engineering teams on scientific priorities, technical architecture, project execution, and evaluation criteria tied to client and product objectives. * Develop Talent and Organizational Excellence: Mentor and develop Data Scientists across experience levels, foster deep expertise in core scientific disciplines, and cultivate a culture of technical excellence, rigorous experimentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.
**Qualifications**
* U.S. Citizenship is required
**Required Skills**
* 7+ years of experience in Data Science or Applied AI, with a proven track record of leading large-scale, company-wide Data Science initiatives from ideation to production and delivering significant impact on products and business outcomes. * Broad understanding of Data Science foundations, with deep expertise in one or more core areas such as optimization, simulation, reinforcement learning, forecasting, causal inference, computer vision, natural language processing, decision science, or foundation model training. * Proven ability to lead complex Data Science projects end to end, define scientific roadmaps, establish technical direction, and drive execution from problem formulation and model development through evaluation and production deployment. * Strong understanding of AI system architectures and internals, including agentic systems, with the ability to design and implement customized, scalable, and highly optimized solutions. * Experience with AI-assisted software development tools such as Claude Code to accelerate development, improve engineering productivity, and scale the delivery capacity of Data Science and Applied AI teams. * Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives involving Data Science, AI Research, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Platform, and Product teams, translating product requirements into technical roadmaps, robust architectures, and production-ready solutions integrated with client data platforms and workflows. * Strong technical leadership and communication skills, with the ability to align AI strategy with client and business needs, drive timely delivery, mentor and develop Data Scientists, and promote technical excellence, innovation, and continuous learning across the organization. * Demonstrated ability to influence technical strategy across organizational boundaries, build alignment among senior technical and product stakeholders, and establish standards adopted across multiple teams.
**Desired Skills**
* Current possession of a U.S. security clearance, or the ability to obtain one with our sponsorship * Experience in or exposure to the nuances of a startup or other entrepreneurial environment * Experience building and scaling reusable Data Science capabilities and modeling platforms that support multiple products, clients, and deployment environments. * Experience designing and evaluating agentic AI systems, including tool use, orchestration, long-horizon execution, retrieval, and integration with specialized models and analytical tools. * Familiarity with modern AI research and development practices, including foundation model adaptation, synthetic data generation, reinforcement learning, and systematic model evaluation. * Experience developing robust experimentation and evaluation frameworks that measure model quality, system reliability, and impact on end-to-end client outcomes. * Experience working with complex enterprise or government datasets, particularly in defense, logistics, supply chain, sustainment, acquisition, or other domai

item.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer, Recommendation Platform (Feature Platform) - ByLabs
item.description:
**About the Role**
As a Principal Recommendation Platform Engineer, you will help upgrade our core recommendation architecture and feature platform, evolving our current rule-based personalization system into an industrial-grade, large-scale, real-time machine learning recommendation platform. The role spans key business scenarios, including trading products, content feeds, the community, and AI-powered investment workflows such as TradeGPT.
You will work closely with recommendation algorithm, growth product and operations, and data science teams to build a high-throughput, low-latency, highly available foundation for personalization at scale, serving more than 80 million users globally. You will lead architectural decisions, infrastructure development, and end-to-end delivery, taking the platform from zero to one in a resource-constrained, fast-moving environment.
**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop high-throughput, low-latency recommendation services. Continuously improve system performance and reliability, and establish robust degradation and disaster-recovery mechanisms. * Build stream-and-batch feature computation and training data pipelines to support minute-level updates of user behavior features. Develop a Feature Store that unifies online and offline features, address temporal feature leakage and feature consistency issues, and support faster model iteration and performance improvements. * Identify common architectural needs across recommendation scenarios—including trading products, content feeds, and community—and optimize their workflows. Build reusable platform capabilities to address technical challenges and business requirements. * Develop and optimize core recommendation components, and drive the engineering and business adoption of emerging technologies, including LLMs and AI agents.
**Major Requirements**
* At least 4 years of recommender systems engineering experience at a consumer internet company. You have played a significant role in, or led, the launch or architectural modernization of a real-time recommendation system serving tens of millions of users. Experience building a recommendation system or feature platform from the ground up is preferred. * Strong computer science fundamentals and proficiency in at least one of Go, Java, or C++. You write well-structured code, apply sound design principles, and enjoy tackling challenging engineering problems. * Experience with stream-and-batch data processing and feature and training data pipelines, including hands-on experience resolving stream-processing latency and data backlog issues. Familiarity with the deployment and performance tuning of mainstream big-data systems, key-value stores, and vector databases. * A platform-oriented approach to architecture and standardization. Experience developing core modules for a large-scale recommendation platform, feature platform, experimentation platform, or high-performance RPC framework is preferred. * A deep understanding of the recommendation system lifecycle, with the ability to collaborate effectively with algorithm teams and translate model requirements into reliable production systems.
**Nice-to-have:**
* Architecture experience in search, advertising, or recommendations at major technology companies * Experience as a key engineer building cross-business feature platforms, large-scale online and offline feature services, or embedding feature pipelines. * Experience with multi-region deployment, data synchronization, active-active architectures, or cross-region RPC latency optimization. * An AI-driven approach and hands-on experience bringing LLM or agent applications into production for search, advertising, or recommendation use cases.
**Why Join Us**
* **A multi-domain recommendation challenge in fintech:** Go beyond a single domain such as video or e-commerce. You will build personalization capabilities across trading products, market intelligence, community content, campaigns, and AI-powered investment workflows. * **Proven business impact with substantial room for ML advancement:** Our current recommendation system has demonstrated a 71% increase in CTR and a 1,285% increase in conversion rate, with significant potential for an ML-native upgrade. * **Work at the intersection of AI and recommendations:** Build where traditional recommender systems, generative AI, and LLM agents meet—one of the most active frontiers in engineering. * **An opportunity to lead, not just follow:** Our combination of trading, content, community, AI, and campaigns creates distinctive technical challenges and enables rapid iteration. * **Global scale:** Serve more than 80 million users across over 200 countries, tackling the real-world complexity of large-scale, real-time systems.

item.title: (USA) Senior, Machine Learning Engineer - Walmart
item.description:
Position Summary...The Senior Machine Learning Engineer will lead the design, development, and deployment of scalable machine learning solutions that address complex business challenges, with a primary focus on building auto-research capabilities that automate model training optimization, experimentation, and evaluation to accelerate the ML development lifecycle. This role requires collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver robust, production-ready models and data pipelines while ensuring compliance with security and governance standards. Additionally, they will provide technical leadership, mentor peers, and drive continuous improvement to enhance system reliability and innovation aligned with organizational goals.
About the team:
Our team develops foundational models tailored for Walmart’s e-commerce platform by leveraging large-scale user interactions to create rich representations of users, products, and search queries. These models enable scalable search, advertising, recommendation, and personalization solutions. Team members apply expertise in data science, machine learning, and software engineering to optimize model performance, training, and deployment. With a strong focus on data quality, advanced analytics, and impactful visualization, the team delivers actionable insights that influence key business outcomes. Cross-functional collaboration drives innovation and continuous improvement in a dynamic technology environment.
What you'll do...
* Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, and product teams to deliver machine learning features and models. * Design and develop auto-research capabilities that automate model training, optimization, experimentation, and evaluation, enabling AI agents to iteratively tune hyperparameters and run experiments against defined objective metrics. * Surface the best-performing models with minimal manual intervention, accelerating the overall machine learning development lifecycle. * Implement, test, and support machine learning services, APIs, and data pipelines, ensuring quality and reliability. * Apply MLOps practices, including CI/CD, model versioning, and automated retraining, to sustain performance. * Conduct rigorous model evaluation, monitoring, and maintenance to address model drift and performance issues. * Ensure secure, compliant machine learning engineering aligned with enterprise AI governance standards.
What you'll bring:

item.description:

We're building out a high-velocity team of multi-disciplinary experts to turn real-world operations into high-quality data for our autonomous partners. Autonomy is now a data race—and Uber has an edge: We collect rare, real-world driving data at a scale and capital efficiency no one else can match.

* 2+ years of working experience in the ML/Robotics industry. * Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields. * Proficient in Python and Linux environments. * Familiar with modern AI/ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch).

* Experience in the Autonomous Driving domain. * Proven track record of deploying ML models in safety-critical physical systems. * Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Vision, Robotics, or Machine Learning. * Familiarity with C++ and high-performance computing.
